text:
kevin_sales: heads up — FinEdge POC hitting lots of 429s when they do embeddings -> chat combo. Started 10:00 PST. They see ~60% 429s during baseline 5 RPS.
ajay_eng: what's the exact error body and headers? can you paste a raw response?
kevin_sales: pasted below

kevin_sales: ```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Policy: per-route
X-RateLimit-Limit: 300
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 23
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "detail": "Token budget exhausted: route=/v1/chat/completions, bucket=60s"
}
```

maria_sre: hmm looks like token-budget enforcement (not requests/sec). embeddings + chat in same session consume tokens quickly.
ajay_eng: confirm — FinEdge is sending 1 embedding request and then 2 chat turns per user, each chat uses ~800 tokens. That can blow a 60s token bucket.
oliver_infra: I see from logs: tenant_id=finedge env=hosted pool=shared model=gptx-3. TokenBucket(bucket_seconds=60, capacity_tokens=12000) but burst_size capped by per-route cap 2000 tokens.
kevin_sales: customer says they had a short spike after importing ~200 docs; they retried with exponential backoff and hit repeated 429s.
sudha_csm: customer asks if we can temporarily raise quota for POC and whether it affects billing.
maria_sre: short answer: yes we can bump token budget on hosted for POC. need SRE approval + note on billing. Also suggest client changes: reduce parallelism and add jitter to retries.
ajay_eng: suggested client-side change:

ajay_eng: ```json
{"max_concurrent": 4, "retry": {"backoff_ms": [200, 500, 1000], "jitter": 0.25}}
```

oliver_infra: ops checklist: (1) confirm token-budget bump duration (48h?), (2) route-specific cap increase for /v1/chat/completions, (3) monitor x-rate headers + traces.
maria_sre: I'll approve a 48h bump to token bucket capacity for finedge-prod-demo. @oliver_infra can you execute? :thumbsup:
oliver_infra: will do. applying change now and will post the change-id.
rate-limiter-bot: change applied: change_id=chg_20260321_001 policy=token_bucket tenant=finedge duration=48h delta_capacity=+30000
kevin_sales: customer confirms tests after change: 429s dropped from 60%->2% and embeddings flow succeeded. They asked about longer-term plan for production.
sudha_csm: next steps — propose Dedicated or higher pooled quota for production, add note on pricing impact. I'll prep the quote.
ajay_eng: also recommend they split embeddings onto separate route if they keep heavy embedding+chat parallelism — that'll avoid shared-token accounting.
kevin_sales: thanks team — closing for now, will follow up with quote request.
